_comment: Made-to-order goods (issue #131 phase 1): game seconds a customer waits at the machine while the item is made, added to the time at the shelf (the mix in the machine is its stock: it keeps 2 days, then it is wasted). Initial values.
_comment_130: Issue #130: a pizza is baked to order (300 s at the oven). Fresh bread is baked in lots (phase 2): restocking the bakery oven puts the dough in the oven (location OVEN, not on sale) for bake_game_seconds; then it moves to the trays and keeps shelf_life_seconds from then (the dough itself keeps 2 days in the backroom). What is left is wasted.
